text:
aya-support: FYI a customer (acct: acme-inc) is getting 429s while the Console shows available tokens in the token-bucket panel. Their requests started failing ~08:42 PDT. sample req id: req_acme_9123
ryan-eng: Can you paste a curl and a screenshot of the panel? also which model/route?
aya-support: Sending screenshot in thread. Route: /v1/generate (default model alias). curl sample:
```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-***' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
```
Also attaching a failing response body: `{ "error": "rate_limited", "code": 429, "trace": "d3adb33f" }`
mike-runtime: Quick idea — UI panel reads token-bucket view from metrics-store cache (TTL 60s). Enforcer consults token-store directly. If ingest of usage events lags >60s you can see available tokens in UI but enforcer already exhausted them. Could be an ingest lag or replay backlog.
jules-sre: Any evidence of a backlog? ops-bot: ingest-processor lag alert: consumer lag spikes 08:40-08:46 (partition 7) — backlog ~42k msgs.
aya-support: Good catch. Customer timeline: calls at 08:41-08:45 hit 429s. Panel still showed ~500 tokens available at 08:43 screenshot.
ryan-eng: Can we confirm token-store vs metrics-store values for that account at ~08:43? mike, can you run a quick diff?
mike-runtime: Running quick lookup for acme-inc: token-store available=0 at 2034567750, metrics-store view snapshot=520 at 2034567735. Looks like metrics snapshot is older than token-store change. I suspect ingest ordering — tokens consumed, then usage events got delayed, metrics snapshot not refreshed.
aya-support: Customer wants postmortem and mitigation. They had traffic for a new campaign.
jules-sre: Short-term mitigation: enable immediate panel refresh (force fetch from token-store) and surface "last-updated" timestamps. Long-term: remove optimistic TTL or tie UI to enforcer state for quota panels.
ryan-eng: For now can we push a console hotfix to show staleness and call out enforcement lag? Also add a link to incident playbook.
mike-runtime: I can push a quick change to make the panel show "live" vs "cached" and wire the live check to token-store (read-only, lightweight). Will roll in next 10 min if no objections.
aya-support: Please do. Also need a clear customer message and a root cause note we can send.
ryan-eng: Draft to send to customer: short explanation, what we did (forced panel to live view, investigating delivery lag), ETA for fix and offer to refund any blocked requests. I'll draft now.
jules-sre: Followups for postmortem: (1) root cause: ingest pipeline lag/replay, (2) missing UI invariants between panel and enforcer, (3) action items: change TTL, add live-check option, alert when token-store and metrics-store diverge > X, (4) test harness for replay storm.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline: console-hotfix -> canary STARTED (deploy id: dpl_7791)
mike-runtime: Canary looks clean so far. Will monitor 5 mins then roll.
aya-support: Thanks team — keeping customer updated. I'll paste the request IDs and times in the support ticket.
ryan-eng: Also adding a quick check script for support to run when customers report similar: `./scripts/check_quota_diff.sh acct_id start_ts end_ts` — outputs token-store vs metrics-store snapshots and ingest lag.
mike-runtime: Pushed the canary to prod, console now exposes "view: live" toggle and shows last-updated: 5s ago.
jules-sre: Marking incident for follow-up and scheduling postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT.
aya-support: :thumbsup: going to notify the customer that we've enabled a live panel and are investigating replay backlog.
ryan-eng: Good. If you get more req ids (e.g., req_acme_9124+) drop them here.
aya-support: Will do. Closing loop for now.
